source_document.body:
The Amazon Black Friday Sale is still going for a while longer, and we’ve got a mix of new appearances with longer-running Green Deals, while the massive majority of savings you can jump on being in our Thanksgiving Green Deals hub . First up, we spotted roborock’s latest RockMow Robot Lawn Mowers at up to $2,249 savings for their best prices to date. We also spotted the popular Yozma IN 10 Pro Electric Dirt Bike hitting an exclusively new $1,519 low with increased savings, as well as EGO’s 21-inch Cordless Select Cut and Touch Drive Mower Kit at $580 , the Govee Matter Outdoor Lamp Post at a new $125 low , and more down below.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Massive deals hit Roborock’s latest RockMow robot mowers from $1,400 low (Up to $2,249 off)
As part of Amazon’s ongoing Black Friday Sale , you can find roborock’s latest robot lawn mowers at their best prices of the year. There’s the RockMow X115H Robot Lawn Mower down at $1,399.99 shipped , while the RockMow X130H Robot Lawn Mower is down at $1,749.98 shipped . Down from $2,299 and $3,999, we’ve only seen discounts take the prices down to these rates once before during October’s Prime Day event, and otherwise keep the cost above $1,500 and $2,000. You can score them with the biggest savings of the year, landing back at their all-time lows for the second time since releasing in mid-June.
Yozma’s IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike bundle just got better at exclusive new $1,519 low ($930 off), more from $949
As Amazon’s Black Friday Sale continues, which you should check out, we just noticed a new low price over in Yozma’s Black Friday EV Sale for the IN 10 Pro Electric Dirt Bike with a FREE cycling bag ($50 value) down at $1,519.05 shipped , after using our exclusive code Electrek at checkout. Down from $2,399, it previously was exclusively down at $1,614 during this sale, but things have ramped up further for $880 savings ($930 total), landing at the best price we have tracked to date. You can also find the standard IN 10 model down at $949.05 shipped , as well as the newest IN 11 Stunt-Ready Electric Dirt Bike at $1,424.05 shipped – both getting the same FREE $50 value bundle at those prices after using the above code.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
***Note: Don’t forget our exclusive code Electrek that needs to be used at checkout to score the prices you see below. Likewise, there are bundle options on each of the models’ landing pages.
IN 10 Electric Mini Dirt Bike: $949 (Reg. $1,599) for riders 3.94 to 5.9 feet tall max 43 MPH for up to 53 miles
IN 11 Stunt-Ready Electric Mini Dirt Bike: $1,424 (Reg. $1,599) for riders 3.94 to 5.9 feet tall max 45 MPH for up to 55 miles
IN 10 Pro Electric Dirt Bike: $1,519 (Reg. $2,399) for riders 4.7 to 6.3 feet tall max 50 MPH for up to 60 miles
EGO’s advanced 21-inch Select Cut + Touch Drive cordless lawn mower with 2x batteries down at $580 (Reg. $779)
Among the many Amazon Black Friday deals , there’s a chance to grab the EGO Power+ 21-inch Select Cut Touch Drive Cordless Electric Self-Propelled Lawn Mower with 2x 4.0Ah batteries down at $579.99 shipped . Down from $779, you’re looking at the exact price that was available during October’s Prime Day event. While things have dipped lower earlier in the year, you’re looking at a solid $199 markdown that gives you one of EGO’s most popular and advanced mowing solutions. You can find more of EGO’s tool deals right here .
Govee’s Matter Outdoor Lamp Post with self-adjusting lights gets largest-ever $175 price cut to a new $125 low, more
As Amazon’s Black Friday deals roll on, you can find the Govee Outdoor Lamp Post with Matter down at $124.99 shipped for the first time ever. We saw it fall to $140 from its $300 full price earlier in the month, with that rate now beaten out by the increased seasonal savings here. You’re looking at a 58% markdown for $175 in savings, landing it at a new all-time low price. You can also find Govee’s massive lineup of other smart lighting deals right here at up to 64% off.
EcoFlow’s official Black Friday Sale cuts up to 52% off power stations + bonus savings – all starting from $459
EcoFlow has officially launched its full expanded Black Friday Power Station Sale , complete with bonus extra savings, 2x member points from purchases, and more. A favorite among the massive lineup (which includes the new TITAN and DELTA Gen4 series) is the DELTA 3 Ultra 3,072Wh Power Station down at $1,300.55 shipped , after using the sitewide code EFBFCMAFF at checkout, beating Amazon by $68 . Down from $1,599 to $1,369 initially, which already beats out the common $1,399 rate we’ve regularly seen this year, the bonus 5% savings lend towards cutting an additional $68 off the tag. While it has dipped a little lower in the past, you’re still getting a solid $298 markdown for the third-lowest price of the year.
***Note: We have not factored in the bonus savings into any of the prices you see below, so be sure to use the code EFBFCMAFF at checkout to guarantee you’re getting the best deals during this event. Just keep in mind that it may not be valid for select units.
Popular options for your backup power needs:
DELTA 3 Max (2,048Wh) power station: $854 (Reg. $1,499)
2x DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh each) power stations: $889 (Reg. $1,198)
DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh) power station: $1,369 (Reg. $1,599)
DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh) with Smart Dual Fuel Generator 3000: $1,799 (No initial price cut)
TITAN 5000 (10kWh) with extra battery: $5,029 (Reg. $7,098)
You can browse the full EcoFlow Black Friday power station lineup right here .
Enjoy low and slow smoky goodness from East Oak’s 30-inch electric smoker down at a $255 2026 low
Rare MOD Bikes savings land for Black Friday – Easy 3 cruiser $200 off, more from $1,799
